The '''''Marshall Awe''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point in its use it was controlled by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strayit]], and had [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] serving on board as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. Whilst Strayit and Strom served on the ship they ended a [[Poporov merchant rebellion|rebellion]] by the [[Poporov merchants]] of [[Armstiss]], during which Strom saved Strayit's life. Due to his heroism, Strom was then promoted off of the ''Marshall Awe'' to the position of [[Executive officer/Legends|First officer]] on board the starship ''[[Peacehawk]]''.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Marshall Awe'' was first mentioned in the second part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The article does not make clear if the ship was active during the [[Rebellion era]] or the [[Rise of the Empire era]].
